saw_lines: Balcony solar buyers compare power output and rules before they click, and most need the install question answered before they pay.
So the sale is won or lost on the page that answers the rules, and unanswered buyers leave.
Your 16 Google text creatives read like developer error messages, so buyers get no reason to act. Lead line one with your site’s 0 % VAT delivery rules instead.
